title: Error when updating the basal profile
symptom: Since update to AAPS 3.0.0.0 and 3.0.0.1, the user repeatedly gets 'Error when updating the basal profile' but only with the Automatisirung (automation) and not every time. Manually changing profile does not cause this. The user uses Android 12 and Dana RS FW 3.
cause: The pump did not respond to the command BASAL__SET_PROFILE_BASAL_RATE and BASAL__SET_PROFILE_NUMBER, but 30 seconds later the same command was successful. It is some kind of pump issue.
fix: No fix provided; the maintainer says there is nothing he can do. The user considered contacting pump support or having the pump replaced.
evidence_quote: It's some kind of pump issue. Pump did't respond to the command but 30 sec later the same command was succesfull. AAPS responded correctly: reported failed command.
